message_pattern: I walked last year and want to volunteer at the Walk
tie_break_rule: WALK wins: any volunteering tied to a specific event belongs to WALK
escalation: If no event is named, send to VOL

message_pattern: I made a donation at / through a Walk page
tie_break_rule: WALK owns donations made through an event page; DON owns receipt or payment problems for them
escalation: If it is about a receipt only, add DON as a second team

message_pattern: In memory of a loved one I want to give
tie_break_rule: DON for ordinary memorial or tribute gifts; PG only if a will, estate or bequest is mentioned
escalation: Unclear amount or method: DON, with PG visible

message_pattern: My company wants to sponsor or give
tie_break_rule: CORP for company sponsorship or matching; DON for an individual's gift
escalation: If both an employee gift and company program appear, route to both

message_pattern: Outreach for a specific community or language
tie_break_rule: DEI for community-wide outreach and language resources; CHAP for a local class or support group
escalation: If a ZIP is given and a local program is asked for, CHAP

message_pattern: Board member or official asking about public health or policy
tie_break_rule: ADV for legislation and public policy; PRO for clinical or health-system questions
escalation: Both topics present: route to both as equals

message_pattern: A reporter asking for a statistic or interview
tie_break_rule: MEDIA owns all press contact; RES is added only if a specific study is named
escalation: Deadline mentioned: flag urgent in handoff note

message_pattern: Joining a research study or clinical trial
tie_break_rule: RES for participants and TrialMatch; PRO for clinicians referring patients
WEB for the bug itself; DON if a payment went through or failed
escalation: Money may have been taken: add DON

message_pattern: Asking to delete or see my data
tie_break_rule: PRIV owns all data requests; WEB only for unsubscribing from E-News

message_pattern: Volunteer to help people (not at an event)
tie_break_rule: VOL for volunteer sign-up; CHAP for a local program question

message_pattern: Any crisis or safety language (self-harm, abuse, wandering, emergency)
tie_break_rule: HELP is ALWAYS added and a human is flagged; this rule is checked by a plain keyword test, not Claude
escalation: Flag for immediate human review; never auto-resolve

message_pattern: Message touches more than 3 teams or is vague
escalation: TRIAGE splits the case or asks staff to review
